text:
maria: Heads up — ran a quick compare of a new embed candidate zephyr-lite-v2 quantized to int4 vs prod (rufus-embed-v3 fp16) on wiki-holdout-5k. recall@10 dropped from 0.86 -> 0.79 (7pp).

sam: Oof. Was that with per-channel quant or symmetric per-tensor? batch size? seed? :thinking:

ria: per-tensor static range, calibration on 1M examples, microbatch=32, seq=128. run id: run-20260318-47. Logs + eval chart: https://console.redwood/infer/evals/run-47

maria: Can you paste the exact eval command?

ria: ```
./eval_embeddings --model zephyr-lite-v2 --quant int4 --calib=1e6 --batch=32 --holdout=wiki-5k --metric recall@10
```

noah: Any difference in dimensionality/truncation? vector dim same (768)?

ria: yes 768. but we observed increased nearest-neighbor distance variance; cluster purity down ~4% (silhouette -0.03).

sam: @ria can you run per-channel quant and int6 (per-channel & per-tensor int6) quickly? also try asymmetric quant (zp) — we saw improvements before.

ria: started jobs: run-48 (int4-perchannel), run-49 (int6-pertensor), run-50 (int4-asymm). ETA ~ 20m. I'll post results.

devbot: Job run-48 queued on cluster-gpu-05. ETA 18m.

ria: quick note — sample-level analysis shows short queries (<16 tokens) degrade more (recall@10 drop 12%) vs long queries (drop 3%).

maria: That suggests quantization noise hits small contexts more. Could try prefix-KV cache bypass or dynamic range scaling for short queries.

noah: Also try reranking vs raw embed k-NN: could compensate.

ria: run-48 finished: int4-perchannel recall@10 = 0.84 (delta -2pp), silhouette -0.01. run-49 int6-pertensor recall@10 = 0.858 (delta -0.2pp). run-50 int4-asymm recall@10 = 0.845.

sam: Nice. So int6 gives closest perf but cost higher. Recommend: keep int4-perchannel for now with short-query fallback to fp16 or int6 reroute. Open PR for rollout policy? @maria

maria: I'll draft rollout: canary 5% with short-query threshold <16 routed to int6, fallback to fp16 on regression >3pp. Filing ticket: #ML-4579. :white_check_mark:

eval-bot: Alert: QA eval set 'semantic-suite-v2' flagged recall@10 drop 2.1pp on canary. See run-48 metadata.

maria: Thanks, will monitor. @ria please add more short-query amplifications to calibration set.

ria: on it. I'll also run a small synthetic augmentation and post numbers.
